name: DeoVR Player
summary: The universal native VR video player across Meta Quest, PCVR, and PICO—supporting 8K passthrough, hardware haptics sync, and direct browser streaming.
ranking_rationale: Mandatory install for VR adult viewing thanks to crisp WebXR playback, DLNA network streaming, and universal Handy/Lovense/Kiiroo synchronization.

pricing.model: Freemium (player free; DeoVR Premium creator hub optional)
pricing.free_tier: Full local, DLNA, and WebXR VR playback free
pricing.notes: Core VR video player app is free across Quest, SteamVR, and PICO stores.

pros: Sharp 8K/120fps hardware decoding with per-eye IPD, zoom, and tilt sliders
Built-in passthrough alpha masking for mixed-reality VR scenes
Natively connects The Handy, Lovense, Kiiroo, and OSR devices
Integrated browser loads SexLikeReal and major VR studios effortlessly
cons: Built-in DeoVR social feed restricts explicit content unless streaming third-party sites/DLNA
Occasional controller UI clutter during transport scrubbing

image.alt: DeoVR Player logo and brand card

facts.value: Native Bluetooth/Wi-Fi support for The Handy, Lovense, and Kiiroo
Free download on Meta Horizon Store, Steam, and PICO
